label: Line Simulator
info:
## Line Simulator

This tab **pretends to be a packaging line**, so the demo has live data without
real hardware. In a real plant, PLCs or sensors would publish the same MQTT
messages and nothing downstream would change.

The line has three machines, each feeding the next:

| Machine | What it is | Faults you can inject |
|---|---|---|
| press-01 | Hydraulic press | overheat, hydraulic_leak |
| cnc-02 | CNC mill (fed by press-01) | bearing, tool_wear (cumulative) |
| robot-03 | Packing robot (fed by cnc-02) | jam, misgrip (cumulative) |

Every few seconds each machine publishes temperature, vibration, rpm, power,
parts produced, health, state and its build-up signal (hydraulic pressure,
tool wear and scrap rate, recent misgrips) to
`factory/<site>/<line>/<machine>/telemetry`.

**States:** RUNNING, DEGRADED (fault building up), STOPPED (jam, low pressure,
tool change), FAULT (tripped on a safety limit, latched until cleared) and
STARVED (an upstream machine stopped, so no parts arrive).

**Chaos mode** injects a random fault every 45-120 s and repairs it after 2
minutes. It runs alongside faults you inject by hand.

The machine models, fault catalog, scenarios and console live in the
"Simulate machines" function's *On Start* code.

label: Fault Injection
info:
## Fault Injection

Click the buttons on the left of an inject node to change the line. The same
commands are available from:

- the **control room** page `/control` (buttons, scenarios and a terminal)
- the REST API: `POST /api/fault {"machine":"press-01","fault":"overheat"}`
- MQTT: publish `{"fault":"overheat"}` to `factory/<site>/<line>/press-01/cmd`,
  or `on` / `off` to `factory/<site>/<line>/chaos`

Only commands addressed to this factory's site/line are applied here.
`none` clears every fault on a machine (and resets trips, tool wear and misgrips).

label: Control Room & API
info:
## Control room and REST API

All endpoints use the stack login (HTTP basic auth).

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GET /control` | Control-room web page |
| `GET /api/status` | Line state, faults, alerts, every joined line |
| `POST /api/fault` | `{"machine","fault"[,"site","line"]}`; other lines are reached over MQTT |
| `POST /api/chaos` | `{"enabled":true}` |
| `POST /api/scenario` | `{"name":"leak-cascade"}` |
| `POST /api/console` | `{"command":"help"}` (the terminal) |
| `GET /api/feed?since=N` | Recent MQTT traffic on `factory/#` |

label: Analytics & Alerts
info:
## Analytics & Alerts

Subscribes to telemetry from **every** line on the broker (this factory and
any factory joined to it over an MQTT bridge):

- **Rules engine** raises edge-triggered alerts (temperature, vibration,
  hydraulic pressure, tool wear, scrap rate, misgrips, machine state) on
  `factory/<site>/<line>/alerts`
- **InfluxDB writer** stores telemetry and alerts in bucket `telemetry`
- **Pipeline stats** (every 10 s) record write counts, MQTT traffic and
  Mosquitto `$SYS` statistics for the health dashboards
- **Live feed** keeps recent `factory/#` traffic for the control room
